title: Vietnamese Velvety Tofu Soup
description: A comforting and creamy soup that combines the best of Vietnamese flavors with velvety texture and the protein-packed goodness of tofu.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the velvety soup and bring to a simmer.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and add to the pot.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs or scallions if desired.
Optional: Serve with rice noodles or crusty bread for a filling meal.
